claims.text: ARF needing secondary prophylaxis: penicillin G benzathine recommended
claims.quote: A single intramuscular dose of penicillin G benzathine 600,000 units (if <27 kg) or 1.2 million units (if >27 kg) may also be used for GAS eradication therapy and may be preferable, as penicillin G benzathine is the recommended therapy for patients with ARF requiring secondary antibiotic prophylaxis.

claims.text: IM penicillin G benzathine q28 days
claims.quote: intramuscular penicillin G benzathine every 28 days
In populations with a higher incidence of ARF, injections should be administered every 21 days.
